field.label: Enable Magic Link
field.comment: When enabled, the withdrawal CTA in order/shipment confirmation emails uses a one-click ?t=TOKEN URL (lifetime configurable below). When disabled, the CTA falls back to the lookup-form URL /withdraw-contract/ (the Lite default) — customers enter their order number + email manually. Tokens already issued keep resolving until their lifetime expires; toggling this flag does not revoke active tokens.

field.label: Token Lifetime (days)
field.comment: How many days a ?t=TOKEN link in the order/shipment email stays valid. Default 30 — enough to cover the typical EU timeline of shipment plus the 14-day post-delivery withdrawal window, so a customer opening an old email can still use the one-click link. The new value applies only to tokens issued from now on; previously issued tokens keep their original expiry.
